title: What If You Had Admin Commands?

publish.title: What If You Had ADMIN Commands in Real Life? #shorts
publish.description: What if you woke up with Roblox admin commands in real life? Flying, zero gravity, pizza rain... until Jay touches the keyboard! Would you trust your best friend with admin?
publish.caption: What if you had admin commands in real life? ⌨️🍕 #roblox #whatif #shorts

scenes.line: What if you woke up with *admin* commands?
scenes.title: WHAT IF YOU HAD ADMIN?

scenes.line: My phone glowed with a cursor, so I typed semicolon *speed*.
My legs kicked into hyperdrive and launched me *outside*.
I skidded to a halt, leaving a massive cloud of *dust*.
Zoe dropped her books and stared like I was an *alien*.
I told her to watch closely, then typed semicolon *fly*.
My sneakers lifted four feet straight off the concrete *sidewalk*.
Zoe cheered, so I spawned a floating pink umbrella in her *hand*.
We floated all the way downtown to show off at the *cafe*.
At the cafe, Jay was crying because he could not afford *pizza*.
I grinned and typed semicolon *spawn* pizza seventy times.
Dozens of golden pizza boxes rained down out of thin *air*.
Jay hugged the warm boxes like they were pure *treasure*.
At the skate park, Jay wiped pizza grease and eyed my *phone*.
Before I could react, Jay snatched the screen with a loud *whoop*.
I shouted at him never to touch the command console *ever*.
Jay chuckled and loudly typed semicolon *gravity* set to zero.
A wild electric rumble shook the ground beneath our *shoes*.
Suddenly, our feet completely broke contact with the cold *ground*.
Down on the road, Officer Dan was drinking his morning *coffee*.
The officer gasped as he floated straight up past a street *light*.
He waved his arms furiously and blew his loud emergency *whistle*.
Jay panicked in mid-air and mashed another random button for *help*.
He accidentally typed semicolon *dance*, forcing our bodies into mid-air disco.
Even the angry officer was floating upside down doing the *dab*.
During an aggressive spin, the phone slipped out of Jay's *fingers*.
The phone drifted toward space, threatening to leave us stuck in *orbit*.
I kicked off a floating billboard and launched into a desperate *leap*.

scenes.line: I snatched the device near the clouds and typed semicolon *land*.
Soft magical umbrellas appeared and floated everyone gently toward the *grass*.
We all landed safely with a soft bump on the park *lawn*.
Officer Dan confiscated Jay's admin privileges for the rest of his *life*.
My admin powers vanished, but Zoe still got to keep the *pizza*.
